item.tib: rigs sngags rgyal mo'i rgyud las srung gyer mi 'jigs rdzong mkhar
item.coloph: ces gshen rab mchog de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug gtor nas byung ba'i/ gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub pa phyir bzlog pa chen mo/ rigs sngags rgyal mo yi rgyud las/ bsrung gyer mi 'jigs rdzong mkhar 'di nyid snying gi thig ler gyur ba'i grogs mchog bstan 'degs rnams kyis snga phyi kun tu bskul bi' ngor/ snyigs dus kyi rnal 'byor ba kun grol grags pas rgyal rong rnam dag bkod pa'i zhing du/ sa pho rta yi lo la bkod pa 'dis kyang mdo sngags kyis bstan pa rin po che 'di phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas 'gyur cig/
